videos.description: NAME OF THE GAME - Seal the Driveway! / Roblox deleted its own death sound and almost nobody noticed. The oof came from a game called Messiah, released back in 2000. Roblox never actually owned it, so in 2022 they ripped it out of the platform and replaced it with a random grunt. Players were furious. They had already started selling the original oof back to creators for 100 Robux, and only got the full rights in 2025. One sound effect, a three year fight, and to this day people still argue about who actually made it.
